title: Baghdad Phantom: seven still images, then video in the government's first release

tellings.quote: George Knapp and I had reported on something called the Baghdad Phantom. We released seven images which were still shots

plain: An unexplained object nicknamed the Baghdad Phantom was caught on camera over Baghdad, Iraq, according to the filmmaker and journalist Jeremy Corbell. Corbell says that he and the television journalist George Knapp first reported on it by releasing seven still images. He says video of it later came out in the government's own first release, which he presents as official backing for what they had shown.
